about: Producer: notes/halo_kernel_model/plots/make_figure_data.py from analysis/halo_kernel/model/hk_model.json (hk_model.py, kernels_58.npz). FLAMINGO L1_m8 at z = 1, host-halo bins in log10 M200m [Msun/h] (lowest bin: galaxy hosts from 10^9, all halos above 10^11.3; edges clipped to 11.3 and 14.5 for drawing). Nc, Ns: mean sample centrals, satellites per halo. b: large-scale halo bias; bK: large-scale halo-shape bias (P_hE = b bK P_lin at k = 0.02 to 0.08). kappa_obj: per-object regression of galaxy on halo ellipticity; kappa_w: large-scale kernel on the mean-HOD halo fields (k = 0.02 to 0.10); null where Nc < 0.01.
